items.title: Young startups miss out on biotech venture funding rebound, MassBio says
items.summary: A new report found that the sizes of seed rounds and A輪融資 financings for Massachusetts biotech startups are going in opposite directions, as funding slows for young companies with the “riskiest science.”

items.title: STAT+: 美國食藥局（FDA） pauses Regenxbio 基因療法 trial again due to safety concerns
items.summary: The 美國食藥局（FDA） put a hold on a Regenxbio 基因療法 trial again after new safety concerns emerged.

items.title: Safety concerns spur 美國食藥局（FDA） to again halt testing of Regenxbio 基因療法
items.summary: Investigators detected masses on the spines of five patients who received its Hunter syndrome treatment, leading to the program’s second clinical hold this year.

items.title: 美國食藥局（FDA） extends review of Capricor 細胞治療; Pain drug startup to go public
items.summary: The agency is now reviewing an updated application for deramiocel with a “refined” indication. Elsewhere, a startup co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy is taking a speedy path to the public markets.

items.title: Cellares, a 細胞治療 manufacturing specialist, to lay off 100 employees
items.summary: The restructuring comes after an unnamed "large pharmaceutical customer" terminated a contract with the company, Cellares CEO Fabian Gerlinghaus posted on LinkedIn.

items.title: Roche commits to lean-mass preservation with Hanmi obesity deal
items.summary: For $190 million up front and as much as $2.3 billion overall, the Swiss drugmaker is building its portfolio with a shot that aims to spur weight loss but spare muscle tissue.

items.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about a big Roche investment in the U.S., estrogen patch shortages, and more
items.summary: Roche's Genentech will invest $750 million to double the size of its existing production facility in Oregon

items.title: 股東施壓Capricor，禮來加碼投入疫苗市場
items.summary: 生技公司Capricor因股東施壓面臨策略調整，同時藥廠巨頭禮來（Lilly）也宣布將加碼投入疫苗研發與市場布局。

items.title: 眼科藥物生技公司募資1.18億美元，延攬高階人才
items.summary: 一家專注於眼科藥物開發的生技公司，近期成功完成1.18億美元的募資，同時也積極延攬多位高階主管，強化其經營管理團隊。
